description:
USAble Life is seeking Web Developer I/II professionals in a fully remote capacity to design, develop, implement, and test software applications that support our systems and customers. You will work with analysts and senior developers to capture requirements and ensure timely, cost-effective deliverables across multiple projects.

The roles require knowledge of modern web tech, SQL databases, and secure coding practices, with opportunities for growth, pay progression, and company incentives.
